    {
      "question": "统计每个品牌在'服饰鞋包'类下的在售商品中，标价最高与最低之差（保留2位小数），仅包含差额大于200元的品牌，按差额降序排列，返回品牌、价差两列，最多100行。",

    {
      "question": "列出所有'母婴用品'类中成本价低于50元且标价高于200元的在售商品，返回商品名称、标价、成本价、标价/成本价比值（保留4位小数），按比值从高到低排序，最多100行。",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "查询products表中category='母婴用品'、cost_price < 50、list_price > 200、is_active=1的记录，输出product_name、list_price、cost_price、ROUND(list_price / cost_price, 4) AS markup_ratio，ORDER BY markup_ratio DESC LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.category_cost_lt50_price_gt200_active_name_price_cost_markup_ratio_order_by_ratio_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT product_name, list_price, cost_price, ROUND(list_price / cost_price, 4) AS markup_ratio FROM products WHERE category = '母婴用品' AND cost_price < 50 AND list_price > 200 AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY markup_ratio DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "统计各品牌下'家用电器'类在售商品的标价中位数（保留2位小数）和成本价中位数（保留2位小数），仅展示商品数不少于3款的品牌，按标价中位数降序排列，返回品牌、标价中位数、成本价中位数三列，最多100行。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "hard",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "对products表按brand分组，筛选category='家用电器'且is_active=1的商品；使用MySQL 8窗口函数计算中位数：对list_price和cost_price分别用ROW_NUMBER() + COUNT(*)求中位位置后取均值；HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3；ORDER BY标价中位数DESC；输出brand、median_list_price、median_cost_price三列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.brand_category_active_median_price_cost_having_ge3_order_by_median_price_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "WITH ranked AS (SELECT brand, list_price, cost_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY list_price) AS rn_p, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY cost_price) AS rn_c, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY brand) AS cnt FROM products WHERE category = '家用电器' AND is_active = 1) SELECT brand, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rn_p IN (FLOOR((cnt+1)/2), CEIL((cnt+1)/2)) THEN list_price END), 2) AS median_list_price, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rn_c IN (FLOOR((cnt+1)/2), CEIL((cnt+1)/2)) THEN cost_price END), 2) AS median_cost_price FROM ranked GROUP BY brand HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY median_list_price DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {

      "category": "filtering",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "查询products表中category='手机数码'、cost_price BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000、list_price / cost_price > 1.3、is_active=1的记录，输出product_name、cost_price、list_price、ROUND(list_price / cost_price, 4) AS ratio，ORDER BY ratio ASC LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "products.category_cost_range_markup_gt1p3_active_name_cost_price_ratio_order_by_ratio_asc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT product_name, cost_price, list_price, ROUND(list_price / cost_price, 4) AS ratio FROM products WHERE category = '手机数码' AND cost_price BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 AND list_price / cost_price > 1.3 AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY ratio ASC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    }
  ]
